Interface RemoteSessionInterface

      • updateObjectsWithoutHubs

        @OARemoteMethod(noReturnValue=true,
                dontUseQueue=true)
void updateObjectsWithoutHubs(Class c,
                                                                                                       OAObjectKey ok,
                                                                                                       boolean bIsInHub)
        Used to make sure that objects are stored in the server side and wont be GCd. This is used when a client removes an OAObject from hubs, which means it might not be referenceable on the server (and get GC'd) This will keep it referenceable on the server
